t: This is St James's Church in Bermondsey, a Church of England parish church designed by James Savage. It was one of the churches built as a result of the Church Building Acts, and it was completed and consecrated in 1829. It became a separate parish in 1840, and it has been Grade II star listed since 1949. Savage also designed St Luke's Church in Chelsea, a pioneering work of the Gothic Revival, and he was architect to the Middle Temple.
